content_sections.heading: About DHS Salem
content_sections.text: The District Health Society, Salem works under the Department of Public Health and Preventive Medicine and is headed by the District Collector, Salem as Chairman, with the District Health Officer, Salem as Executive Secretary. The Staff Nurse posts in this notice serve the Comprehensive Emergency Obstetric and Newborn Care centres and Special Newborn Care Units (CEmONC & SNCU) under the Joint Director of Health Services, Salem and the Dean, Government Mohan Kumaramangalam Medical College Hospital, Salem, and the new Ammapet Peripheral Hospital under Salem Medical College and Hospital.

content_sections.heading: DHS Salem Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The notice does not print its own date of issue or an application start date. As of 20 November 2026, the application window is open.

content_sections.text: DHS Salem has notified a total of 100 Contract Staff Nurse posts across two units. The notice states that the number of posts is subject to change. It does not give a category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: DHS Salem Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Both posts carry the same printed qualification. Valid registration with the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council is mandatory before the date of notification. A Tamil Nadu Nursing Council registration certificate, renewed up to date, must be submitted with the application. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: DHS Salem Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Posts are filled on the basis of merit marks. The 82 Contract Staff Nurse (CEmONC & SNCU) posts at S.No. 1 are filled first. After that, the 18 Contract Staff Nurse (Government Peripheral Hospital, Ammapet, Salem) posts at S.No. 2 are filled. The notice does not mention a written test or an interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in DHS Salem Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 100 Contract Staff Nurse posts: 82 for CEmONC & SNCU and 18 for the Government Ammapet Peripheral Hospital, Salem (JICA); the number is subject to change.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the DHS Salem Staff Nurse application?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the District Health Society, Salem by 5.00 PM on 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for DHS Salem Staff Nurse posts?
faq.answer: Diploma in General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM) or B.Sc., (Nursing) from a Government or Government approved Private Nursing College, with valid Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council registration before the date of notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for DHS Salem Staff Nurse 2026?
faq.answer: The notice gives the age preference as Upto 50 Years for both posts.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a DHS Salem Contract Staff Nurse?
faq.answer: Rs.21,000 a month for CEmONC & SNCU posts, and Rs.18,000 plus EPF Rs.1,950 a month for the Ammapet Peripheral Hospital (JICA) posts.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: On the basis of merit marks; the 82 CEmONC & SNCU posts are filled first, followed by the 18 Ammapet Peripheral Hospital posts.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for DHS Salem Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Download the form from https://www.salem.nic.in and submit it in person or by Speed Post to the Executive Secretary / District Health Office, District Health Society, Old Nattanmai Building Complex, Salem District - 636 001.

faq.question: Q8. Do I need separate applications for the two Staff Nurse posts?
faq.answer: No, one application is enough for both posts.

faq.question: Q9. Is the DHS Salem Staff Nurse job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the posts are filled on a contract basis and are purely temporary.
